phases.objective: Provide an explicitly authorized, checksum-bound runtime-readiness path that verifies exact Production parity, records governed migration authorization when required, executes a zero-risk dry-run without Apply, and publishes the exact run-bound Artifact back to the control issue without consulting Job logs.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authorized repository operator and governed Migration 1043 readiness workflow
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR comment on control issue #4449
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow proves the current Production SHA and runtime parity, binds Migration 1043 to the reviewed blob and checksum, uses readback-first duplicate prevention, creates only authorization-bootstrap control-plane evidence when needed, completes a governed dry-run with applies_sql=false, uploads sanitized evidence, and never authorizes or executes Apply.
steps: Require the exact checksum-derived authorization comment on issue #4449 from an OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR.
Checkout trusted main and verify it contains the merged repository-readiness contract.
Read the protected Production ref and prove it contains the managed-execution foundation merge.
Verify the Production copy of Migration 1043 has the reviewed Git blob and the runtime reports the same exact Production SHA through health, version, and deployment evidence.
Perform governed migration schema and ledger readback before creating any new authorization evidence.
If the exact apply ledger already exists, report already_applied without creating authorization or dry-run evidence.
Otherwise create and approve only a checksum- and Production-bound capability envelope for governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap.
Bootstrap the exact migration authorization with one bounded previous-checksum rotation path when required.
Execute governed_migration_execute in dry_run mode and require applies_sql=false, the exact checksum and statement count, and a zero-risk preflight.
Upload sanitized Artifact and Job Summary evidence without repository writes, provider calls, business-data mutation, registry synchronization, Apply authorization, or Apply execution.
assertions: The workflow requires the exact issue #4449 confirmation and an allowed repository association.
The workflow never exposes an Apply job and has no push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, or automatic runtime trigger.
The current main branch must contain repository-readiness merge 0cd5e8c894f2877db9de1e1942ff9db25d9ecc5e.
Production must contain foundation merge a1c1f3d4f4b36a3a5764d898194818e3e9ea1ce3 and expose Migration 1043 blob 7f3e0152bcdfba36a659ff4a1df8e30d82024c8c.
Health, version, and deployment-info must converge on one stable protected Production SHA.
Readback occurs before authorization creation and prevents a duplicate readiness mutation when the exact apply ledger is already present.
Authorization bootstrap is bound to Migration 1043, checksum a11dff751fca4df19a6acfc188ca7310d8e1a90aa5c3f06fe0c3efeb1213a2a9, four statements, source PR #4845, and its exact merge SHA.
The dry-run reports mode=dry_run, applies_sql=false, exact checksum and statement count, preflight status pass, and zero risks.
The implementation contains no mode=apply request, no capability_resolution_envelope_apply_authorize call, and no activation authorized-surface registry synchronization.

Managed control-plane authorization evidence may be written only after the explicit operator comment; migration SQL, business data, providers, external business systems, and Production refs remain unmodified.
Artifacts redact sensitive keys and report apply_authorized=false, apply_sent=false, migration_apply_executed=false, activation_registry_sync_executed=false, and secrets_included=false.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Push of the reviewed backfill contract to main or an explicit workflow_dispatch retry
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The publisher verifies authorization comment #5160291051, discovers the first matching issue_comment workflow run, downloads only its exact run-bound Artifact, publishes a bounded idempotent result to issue #4449, and fails closed when the run, Artifact, contract, or no-secret declaration is missing.
steps: Read authorization comment #5160291051 and require the exact Migration 1043 readiness confirmation, issue #4449, owner identity, and allowed author association.
List runs for sprint69-1043-runtime-readiness.yml using event=issue_comment and select the first trusted-main run created after the exact authorization comment.
Poll only the selected run with a bounded window and never consult Job logs.
Require the exact Artifact name sprint69-1043-runtime-readiness-<run_id> and download it through actions/download-artifact.
Accept only the bounded readiness summary or failure contract with secrets_included=false.
Create or update one marker-bound issue comment containing allowlisted status fields, SHA/checksum evidence, dry-run status, and explicit no-Apply declarations.
Upload discovery and publication evidence and fail the publisher when Runtime Readiness did not pass.
assertions: The backfill workflow runs only from trusted main push paths or explicit workflow_dispatch and has actions:read, contents:read, and issues:write without repository write authority.
Authorization is pinned to comment #5160291051 and the exact checksum-derived confirmation; no new authorization comment is created.
The backfill performs no Runtime call, Admin Control request, capability-envelope creation, authorization bootstrap, migration dry-run, or Migration Apply.
The publisher uses the Actions API and run-bound Artifact rather than Job logs.
A missing, incomplete, skipped, or artifact-less run is published as a bounded failure and never retriggered automatically.
Issue publication is idempotent through a run- or comment-bound marker.

The published evidence always reports Apply authorization, Apply send, migration execution, activation registry synchronization, provider call, credential payload access, and external business write status.
No repository mutation, provider call, credential payload access, external business write, or secret persistence occurs.

phases.objective: Retain the exact run-bound Production, authorization-bootstrap, dry-run, and no-secret Artifact evidence on issue #4449 after explicit operator authorization.

Keep Production drift, migration blob drift, runtime parity failure, authorization ambiguity, missing workflow runs, missing Artifacts, checksum rotation, and dry-run preflight risks fail-closed with bounded evidence.
Use the successful checksum- and Production-bound readiness Artifact as a prerequisite for any separately reviewed Migration 1043 Apply contract.
This contract grants no Migration Apply, activation registry synchronization, deployment, provider call, external business write, or Production ref mutation authority.
